newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 41,300 MT were down 12 percent from the prior week, but were two-fifths above the 4-week average. The primary buyer was Turkey (20,000 MT), with smaller quantities for Haiti (7,200 MT), the Netherlands (3,300 MT), Mexico (3,000 MT--all rough), the Leeward and Windward Islands (1,600 MT), and Belgium (1,300 MT). In addition, there were reductions of 100 MT of rough rice for El Salvador.

Exports of 18,300 MT were 58 percent below the week earlier and one-half under the 4-week average. The major destinations were the Netherlands (6,000 MT), Mexico (3,500 MT), El Salvador (2,400 MT), and Canada (1,400 MT). Note: Reductions of 28,000 MT were made in accumulated exports for Japan because of duplicate reporting.
